Keep as-is. --- ## 2) `src/core/smartdecode/index.js` ❌ Syntax error on segments line This line is broken: ```js const segments = options.splitSegments ? normalized.split(/ +/) [normalized]; ``` Missing `:` in the ternary. ### FIX ```js const segments = options.splitSegments ? normalized.split(/ +/) : [normalized]; ``` ### Also: include URL in refusals for forensic output Right now refusals don’t carry the urlStr. That makes refusal reports weak. Patch these two pushes: ```js refused.push({ host: c?.host || 'unknown', reason: 'incomplete_or_relative_url', status: 'rejected', url: urlStr }); ``` and: ```js refused.push({ host: c?.host || 'unknown', reason: auth.stopReason || 'requires_auth', status: 'rejected', url: urlStr }); ``` ### Final corrected `index.js` core (minimal patch) ```js "use strict"; const Preprocessor = require('./preprocessor'); const DirectExtractor = require('./direct'); const Base64Extractor = require('./base64'); const AuthBoundaryDetector = require('./auth-boundary'); const SmartDecode = { VERSION: '2.2.0', async run(input, options = {}) { const normalized = Preprocessor.normalize(input); const segments = options.splitSegments ? normalized.split(/ +/) : [normalized]; let allAccepted = []; let allRefused = []; for (const segment of segments) { if (!segment.trim()) continue; const result = await this.processSegment(segment, options); allAccepted.push(...result.candidates); allRefused.push(...result.refusals); } const sortC = (a, b) => (String(a.host) + String(a.type)).localeCompare(String(b.host) + String(b.type)); const sortR = (a, b) => (String(a.host) + String(a.reason)).localeCompare(String(b.host) + String(b.reason)); return { version: this.VERSION, candidates: allAccepted.sort(sortC), refusals: allRefused.sort(sortR) }; }, async processSegment(html) { const candidates = []; const refused = []; const hasPacked = /eval\(function\(p,a,c,k,e,d\)/i.test(html); if (hasPacked) { const staticUrls = DirectExtractor.extract(html) || []; if (staticUrls.length === 0) { refused.push({ host: 'packed_js_block', reason: 'dynamic_execution_required', status: 'rejected' }); return { candidates: [], refusals: refused }; } } const raw = [ ...(DirectExtractor.extract(html) || []), ...(Base64Extractor.extract(html, DirectExtractor) || []) ]; const seen = new Set(); for (const c of raw) { const urlStr = String(c?.url || ''); if (!urlStr || seen.has(urlStr)) continue; seen.add(urlStr); if (!/^https?:///i.test(urlStr)) { refused.push({ host: c?.host || 'unknown', reason: 'incomplete_or_relative_url', status: 'rejected', url: urlStr }); continue; } const auth = AuthBoundaryDetector.check(urlStr, html); if (auth?.requiresAuthorization) { refused.push({ host: c?.host || 'unknown', reason: auth.stopReason || 'requires_auth', status: 'rejected', url: urlStr }); } else { candidates.push({ ...c, status: 'accepted', url: urlStr }); } } return { candidates, refusals: refused }; } }; module.exports = SmartDecode; ``` --- ## 3) `verify_golden.js` ❌ Syntax errors + truncations You have **two breaks**: ### (A) `readFileSync` call missing comma This is broken: ```js const goldenRaw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./goldens/baseline.json' 'utf8')); ``` Fix: ```js const goldenRaw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./goldens/baseline.json', 'utf8')); ``` ### (B) `splitSegments: fals` typo Fix: ```js const results = await SmartDecode.run(input, { splitSegments: false }); ``` ### (C) Projection line is truncated: `c.hos` etc Make sure this line is correct: ```js candidates: (results.candidates || []).map(c => ({ host: c.host, type: c.type, status: c.status })), ``` --- ## 4) `hypersnatch.html` ❌ Multiple hard breaks You have **three**: ### (A) `accepted.lengt` typo + missing comma Broken: ```js const manifest = { version: "2.2.0", count: accepted.lengt artifacts: accepted }; ``` Fix: ```js const manifest = { version: "2.2.0", count: accepted.length, artifacts: accepted }; ``` ### (B) `new Date()` got mangled (`${n Date()...}`) Broken: ```js Generated: ${n Date().toISOString()} ``` Fix: ```js Generated: ${new Date().toISOString()} ``` ### (C) toast ternary string is broken (missing quote / colon) Broken: ```js this.toast(accepted.length > 0 ? 'Instruction bundle generated : 'Refusal report generated'); ``` Fix: ```js this.toast(accepted.length > 0 ? 'Instruction bundle generated' : 'Refusal report generated'); ``` ### Optional but important: don’t name output by host This creates collisions. Use a URL basename if you have it: - if you already have `basenameFromUrl(url)`, use it - otherwise at least include index or timestamp in filename Example: ```js const outName = this.sanitizeFilename((this.basenameFromUrl?.(c.url) || (c.host || 'file')) + ''); ``` --- # Bottom line Right now, your build fails for **basic syntax reasons** (ternary, missing commas, typos). Fix the above and it will run and produce deterministic results. If you paste `direct.js`, `base64.js`, and `auth-boundary.js`, I’ll tell you immediately whether they’re consistent with your “fixture expectations” (and where they’ll misclassify).
